name: _enabled
doc: Generic component flag accepted on biome components; its effect here was not traced

name: material_index
doc: Sort key: components are tested in ascending material_index order, not XML order (range -100..100)

name: material_min
doc: Inclusive lower bound on the cave noise value

name: material_max
doc: Exclusive upper bound on the cave noise value

name: add_perlin
doc: Add perlin(x * add_perlin_scale_x, 0) to the value before the range test

name: add_perlin_scale_y
doc: Parsed but never read: the perlin's second argument is always 0

name: is_rare
doc: Enables the rare_* gates; 0 skips them entirely

name: limit_y
doc: Only place between limit_min_y and limit_max_y

name: limit_min_y
doc: Inclusive lower bound on pixel y, used with limit_y

name: limit_max_y
doc: Inclusive upper bound on pixel y, used with limit_y

name: rare_use_fbm_perlin
doc: Use fbm instead of plain perlin for the rare gate

name: rare_offset_by_seed
doc: if set, will add worldseed to x,y

name: rare_offset_x
doc: adds this offset before calling the noise functions

name: rare_offset_y
doc: adds this offset before calling the noise functions

name: rare_required_min
doc: Exclusive lower bound for both rare gates

name: rare_required_max
doc: Inclusive upper bound for both rare gates

name: is_polygon
doc: If 1, uses the points of the <polygon> child to decide whether this material is placed
